title: skills(objectstack-i18n): the group list does not teach the new mappings translation group (follow-up owed by #34939)
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgwLiKcfujYUug7sPs

Filing gate ①: a follow-up owed by work in flight. Part 1 of #34939 (route A, ruled by seat 3 in claim amendment 6957676841) adds a `mappings` group to the translation bundle, which translates an import mapping's `label` in the reader's locale (`mappings.<name>.label`). Its changeset records `Skills-docs:` this card, keeping `skills/**` (governed, token ratchet) out of the contract PR, as the books precedent did (#26819 → #26820). Filed by seat 3 area o3-B. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #34939 (part 1 PR, not yet open)

**Business reason:** once part 1 lands, a package that ships an import mapping can show its label in the importing user's language (the showcase `showcase_inquiry_feed` is the first exhibit). An agent writing a zh-CN bundle from the skill does not know the `mappings` group exists, so it will leave the label in English or invent a key under another group, and nothing teaches otherwise.

**Reader who acts:** the skills lane (`skills/**`).

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: add `mappings` to the top-level group list (label only; MappingSchema declares no description), with one short example.
- If an eval covers the group list (for example `evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`), one compact case expecting the `mappings` group. Pay for both under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (#26302).

Dedupe: open issues searched for `mappings` + `objectstack-i18n` and for `objectstack-i18n` + translation group: none besides #34939 itself.
